96	# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
97	#  Mamba-3 TOY config (mirrors mamba3_oracle.TOY + mlp_ratio=2 — the live model the
98	#  L3-TC tail gate builds: 45 params, 593713 elements). The oracle wrappers below
99	#  build a live Mamba3Model with THIS config and load the gate's `named` dict.
100	# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
101	_M3_CFG = dict(p=97, ntok=99, seq_len=8, d=128, nl=2, state_dim=128,
102	               head_dim=64, expand_factor=2, mlp_ratio=2)
103	
104	
105	def _build_m3(named, dtype):
106	    """Build a live Mamba3Model at _M3_CFG in `dtype` and load `named` into it
107	    (cast to `dtype`). `named`'s keys match the model's named_parameters() exactly;
108	    the model ALSO registers a `pos_ids` buffer (not in `named`), so load_state_dict
109	    is called with strict=False (the buffer keeps its registered arange value, which
110	    is what model_forward reads). Returns the live model with grads disabled.
111	
112	    DEVICE: the model is placed on the DEVICE of the incoming `named` tensors. The
113	    gate runs at the production batch (B≈4176) — the Mamba-3 manual fp64 backward
114	    materializes dense [B, n_heads, head_dim, Nc, 2] scan intermediates, which are
115	    pathologically slow on CPU at that B but fast on the H100 (fp64). Running the
116	    fp64 ground-truth oracle on the SAME GPU is faithful (fp64 is fp64) and keeps the
117	    looksam/SG gates from timing out."""
118	    from grokking_optimizers.mamba3_block import Mamba3Model
119	    dev = next(iter(named.values())).device
120	    model = Mamba3Model(**_M3_CFG).to(dtype).to(dev)
121	    sd = {k: v.to(dtype).to(dev) for k, v in named.items()}
122	    model.load_state_dict(sd, strict=False)   # pos_ids buffer (only non-param) kept
123	    for p in model.parameters():
124	        p.requires_grad_(False)
125	    return model
126	
127	
128	# Mamba-3 toy shape constants (replace the old mamba_oracle Mamba-1 globals the
129	# standalone GPU tests used). VOCAB=ntok, P_HEAD=head width p, SEQ=seq_len,
130	# D_MODEL=d. D_INNER = expand_factor*d is the mixer inner width (out_proj's K).
131	VOCAB = _M3_CFG["ntok"]
132	P_HEAD = _M3_CFG["p"]
133	SEQ = _M3_CFG["seq_len"]
134	D_MODEL = _M3_CFG["d"]
135	D_INNER = _M3_CFG["expand_factor"] * _M3_CFG["d"]
136	
137	
138	# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
139	#  The bf16-FAITHFUL fp64 Mamba-3 oracle (the named R2 reference): the Mamba-3
140	#  oracle's fwd+bwd PRIMITIVES (mamba3_oracle.*) re-run in fp64 with EVERY value
141	#  the Mamba-3 TC kernel STORES rounded to bf16 at the SAME points. The PRECISION
142	#  FORK (the standard bf16-faithful contract the decoder/vit oracles use, applied
143	#  to Mamba-3's projection set — Sec 3.4 dropped the conv1d + SSM-input SiLU):
144	#    * EVERY Linear/GEMM rounds its A-operand (the input ACTIVATION) to bf16, and
145	#      EVERY Linear's dY (output-grad) adjoint is rounded to bf16. The weight is
146	#      also taken bf16 as the GEMM's other operand (matches the wgmma operands).
147	#    * The 7 per-block projections are in_proj, x_proj, dt_proj, out_proj (mixer)
148	#      + gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj (SwiGLU MLP); plus the head out-Linear.
149	#    * layer-boundary residual stream rounded bf16 (each block's input `h` is the
150	#      in_proj A-operand AND the residual add; the final stream into the head norm
151	#      is fp32, like the kernel's last-layer output).
152	#    * RMSNorm / SiLU / softplus / sigmoid / the complex-trapezoidal SCAN / the
153	#      D-skip / the gate / cross-entropy: fp32 (fp64 here) — NOT rounded. The scan
154	#      is the Mamba-3 analogue of the Mamba-1 selective scan (kept scalar/fp32).
155	#    * dt_proj has a bias (added in fp32); cross-entropy + the scalar head dlogits
156	#      are fp32 (no bf16), matching the Mamba-1 oracle.
157	#  Re-uses mamba3_oracle's VERIFIED primitive fwd/bwd (rmsnorm_*, silu/silu_grad,
158	#  softplus_grad, scan_forward/backward, cross_entropy_*), inserting bf() at the
159	#  GEMM operands + dY adjoints only — so the scan/RMSNorm/gate math is bit-for-bit
160	#  the pure-fp64 derivation and only the projection boundaries carry bf16 noise.
161	#  Runs on CPU (fp64, tiny) so it never competes with the kernel for GPU memory.
162	#  Tolerance is generous (sam_dir 2.5e-2 / sharpness 3e-2) precisely to absorb the
163	#  bf16-vs-fp64 gap, so this faithful oracle need only be in the right ballpark.
164	# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
165	def _bf16_faithful_mamba_oracle(named, tokens, targets):
166	    import torch.nn.functional as F
167	    from tests.hw.mamba3_oracle import (
168	        silu, silu_grad, softplus_grad, rmsnorm_forward, rmsnorm_backward,
169	        scan_forward, scan_backward, cross_entropy_forward, cross_entropy_backward)
170	    B16 = torch.bfloat16
171	
172	    def bf(x):
173	        return x.to(B16).to(torch.float64)
174	
175	    # Build the live fp64 model so we can read the exact module structure/shapes
176	    # the kernel mirrors, and use named_parameters() (doubled) as the weight dict.
177	    # Keep params on the TOKENS' device so the index_select + matmuls are consistent.
178	    Bn, S = tokens.shape
179	    dev = tokens.device
180	    model = _build_m3(named, torch.float64)
181	    P = {k: v.double().to(dev) for k, v in model.named_parameters()}
182	    nl = len(model.layers)
183	    eps = model.norm.eps
184	
185	    # ---- embedding (bf16 layer-0 input: the in_proj A-operand + residual) ----
186	    pos_ids = model.pos_ids.reshape(-1)[:S].to(dev)
187	    h = bf(P["tok.weight"][tokens] + P["pos.weight"][pos_ids].unsqueeze(0))  # [B,S,d]
188	
189	    caches = []
190	    for li in range(nl):
191	        mixer = model.layers[li].mixer
192	        H, Pp, Nc = mixer.n_heads, mixer.head_dim, mixer.complex_dim
193	        di, dt_rank = mixer.d_inner, mixer.dt_rank
194	        pre = f"layers.{li}."
195	
196	        # ============ Mamba-3 MIXER sub-block (pre-norm + residual) ============
197	        x_block_in = h                                            # bf16 residual stream
198	        xn_mix, mixn_cache = rmsnorm_forward(h, P[pre + "mixer_norm.weight"], eps)
199	        # in_proj (bf16 GEMM): xz = bf(xn_mix) @ bf(W)^T
200	        xn_mix_b = bf(xn_mix)                                     # in_proj A-operand bf16
201	        xz = xn_mix_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.in_proj.weight"]).t()   # fp64 acc
202	        x_main, z = xz.split(di, dim=-1)                          # fp32/fp64
203	        x_in = x_main                                            # NO conv, NO SiLU on SSM input
204	        x_in_b = bf(x_in)                                        # x_proj A-operand bf16
205	        # x_proj (bf16 GEMM)
206	        proj = x_in_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.x_proj.weight"]).t()
207	        dt_lr, A_mod, theta, u_lam, Br, Bi, Cr, Ci = torch.split(
208	            proj, [dt_rank, H, Nc, H, Nc, Nc, Nc, Nc], dim=-1)
209	        # dt_proj (bf16 GEMM, +bias fp32)
210	        dt_lr_b = bf(dt_lr)                                       # dt_proj A-operand bf16
211	        dt_pre = dt_lr_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.dt_proj.weight"]).t() + P[pre + "mixer.dt_proj.bias"]
212	        dt = F.softplus(dt_pre)                                  # [B,L,H]  (fp32)
213	        base_rate = torch.exp(P[pre + "mixer.A_log"])           # [H]
214	        A_arg = A_mod + base_rate.view(1, 1, -1)
215	        A_real = -F.softplus(A_arg)                             # [B,L,H]
216	        lam = torch.sigmoid(u_lam)                              # [B,L,H]
217	        # BCNorm + all-ones biases (fp32)
218	        Brn, Bcache = rmsnorm_forward(Br, P[pre + "mixer.B_norm.weight"], eps)
219	        Bin, Bicache = rmsnorm_forward(Bi, P[pre + "mixer.Bhat_norm.weight"], eps)
220	        Crn, Ccache = rmsnorm_forward(Cr, P[pre + "mixer.C_norm.weight"], eps)
221	        Cin, Cicache = rmsnorm_forward(Ci, P[pre + "mixer.Chat_norm.weight"], eps)
222	        Br2 = Brn + P[pre + "mixer.B_bias"]
223	        Bi2 = Bin + P[pre + "mixer.Bhat_bias"]
224	        Cr2 = Crn + P[pre + "mixer.C_bias"]
225	        Ci2 = Cin + P[pre + "mixer.Chat_bias"]
226	        Bbar = torch.stack((Br2, Bi2), dim=-1)
227	        Cbar = torch.stack((Cr2, -Ci2), dim=-1)
228	        # complex exponential-trapezoidal scan (FP32 — NOT rounded)
229	        x_h = x_in.view(Bn, S, H, Pp)
230	        y_h, scan_cache = scan_forward(x_h, dt, A_real, theta, lam, Bbar, Cbar, H, Pp, Nc)
231	        y = y_h.reshape(Bn, S, di)
232	        # D-skip + gated output (FP32)
233	        y_skip = y + x_in * P[pre + "mixer.D"].view(1, 1, di)
234	        sz = silu(z)
235	        y_gated = y_skip * sz
236	        # out_proj (bf16 GEMM)
237	        y_gated_b = bf(y_gated)                                  # out_proj A-operand bf16
238	        mix_out = y_gated_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.out_proj.weight"]).t()
239	        h1 = x_block_in + mix_out                               # block residual (bf16 stream + fp64 out)
240	
241	        # ============ SwiGLU MLP sub-block (pre-norm + residual) ===============
242	        h1n, mlpn_cache = rmsnorm_forward(h1, P[pre + "mlp_norm.weight"], eps)
243	        h1n_b = bf(h1n)                                          # gate_proj/up_proj A-operand bf16
244	        g_pre = h1n_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.gate_proj.weight"]).t()
245	        u = h1n_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.up_proj.weight"]).t()
246	        s = silu(g_pre)
247	        prod = s * u
248	        prod_b = bf(prod)                                       # down_proj A-operand bf16
249	        mlp_out = prod_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.down_proj.weight"]).t()
250	        h2 = h1 + mlp_out
251	
252	        # next block's input stream is bf16 (its in_proj A-operand + residual);
253	        # the FINAL block's output stays fp32 into the head norm (kernel's last layer).
254	        h = bf(h2) if li + 1 < nl else h2
255	        caches.append(dict(
256	            x_block_in=x_block_in, mixn_cache=mixn_cache, xn_mix_b=xn_mix_b,
257	            x_in=x_in, x_in_b=x_in_b, z=z, dt_lr=dt_lr, dt_lr_b=dt_lr_b,
258	            dt_pre=dt_pre, A_arg=A_arg, base_rate=base_rate, lam=lam,
259	            Bcache=Bcache, Bicache=Bicache, Ccache=Ccache, Cicache=Cicache,
260	            scan_cache=scan_cache, y_skip=y_skip, sz=sz, y_gated=y_gated,
261	            y_gated_b=y_gated_b, h1=h1, mlpn_cache=mlpn_cache, h1n_b=h1n_b,
262	            g_pre=g_pre, u=u, s=s, prod=prod, prod_b=prod_b,
263	            H=H, Pp=Pp, Nc=Nc, di=di, dt_rank=dt_rank, pre=pre))
264	
265	    # ---- final RMSNorm (last token) + scalar head + cross-entropy (fp32) ----
266	    h_last = h[:, -1, :]
267	    hn, nc = rmsnorm_forward(h_last, P["norm.weight"], eps)
268	    logits = hn @ P["out.weight"].t() + P["out.bias"]           # scalar head fp32
269	    loss = cross_entropy_forward(logits, targets)
270	
271	    # ============================ BACKWARD ===================================
272	    grads = {}
273	    dlogits = cross_entropy_backward(logits, targets)           # fp32 (NO bf16)
274	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn
275	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(0)
276	    dhn = dlogits @ P["out.weight"]
277	    dh_last, grads["norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dhn, nc)
278	
279	    d = P["tok.weight"].shape[1]
280	    dh = torch.zeros(Bn, S, d, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64)
281	    dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
282	    for li in reversed(range(nl)):
283	        lc = caches[li]
284	        pre = lc["pre"]
285	        H, Pp, Nc, di = lc["H"], lc["Pp"], lc["Nc"], lc["di"]
286	
287	        # ---- SwiGLU MLP backward (h2 = h1 + mlp(mlp_norm(h1))) ----
288	        d_ff = lc["prod_b"].shape[-1]
289	        dh1 = dh.clone()                                        # residual path
290	        dmlp_out = dh                                          # [B,S,d]
291	        # down_proj [d,d_ff]: dW = dY^T @ prod_b ; dX = dY @ W   (dY adjoint bf16)
292	        dmlp_out_b = bf(dmlp_out)                               # down_proj dY bf16
293	        grads[pre + "mlp.down_proj.weight"] = (
294	            dmlp_out_b.reshape(-1, d).t() @ lc["prod_b"].reshape(-1, d_ff))
295	        dprod = dmlp_out_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.down_proj.weight"])  # fp32 [B,S,d_ff]
296	        ds = dprod * lc["u"]
297	        du = dprod * lc["s"]
298	        dg_pre = ds * silu_grad(lc["g_pre"])
299	        # gate_proj / up_proj: dY adjoints bf16, dW vs h1n_b, dX vs W (bf16)
300	        dg_pre_b = bf(dg_pre); du_b = bf(du)
301	        grads[pre + "mlp.gate_proj.weight"] = dg_pre_b.reshape(-1, dg_pre_b.shape[-1]).t() @ lc["h1n_b"].reshape(-1, d)
302	        grads[pre + "mlp.up_proj.weight"] = du_b.reshape(-1, du_b.shape[-1]).t() @ lc["h1n_b"].reshape(-1, d)
303	        dh1n = dg_pre_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.gate_proj.weight"]) + du_b @ bf(P[pre + "mlp.up_proj.weight"])
304	        dh1_mlpnorm, grads[pre + "mlp_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dh1n, lc["mlpn_cache"])
305	        dh1 = dh1 + dh1_mlpnorm
306	
307	        # ---- Mamba-3 mixer backward (h1 = x + mixer(mixer_norm(x))) ----
308	        dx_block = dh1.clone()                                  # residual path
309	        dmix_out = dh1                                         # [B,S,d]
310	        # out_proj [d,di]: dW = dY^T @ y_gated_b ; dX = dY @ W   (dY adjoint bf16)
311	        dmix_out_b = bf(dmix_out)                               # out_proj dY bf16
312	        grads[pre + "mixer.out_proj.weight"] = dmix_out_b.reshape(-1, d).t() @ lc["y_gated_b"].reshape(-1, di)
313	        dy_gated = dmix_out_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.out_proj.weight"])  # fp32 [B,S,di]
314	        # gate + D-skip backward (FP32)
315	        dy_skip = dy_gated * lc["sz"]
316	        dsz = dy_gated * lc["y_skip"]
317	        dz = dsz * silu_grad(lc["z"])
318	        grads[pre + "mixer.D"] = (dy_skip * lc["x_in"]).sum(dim=(0, 1))
319	        dx_in = dy_skip * P[pre + "mixer.D"].view(1, 1, di)
320	        # scan backward (FP32) — dy [B,L,di] -> [B,L,H,P]
321	        sg = scan_backward(dy_skip.view(Bn, S, H, Pp), lc["scan_cache"])
322	        dx_in = dx_in + sg["dx_h"].reshape(Bn, S, di)
323	        # Cbar = (Cr2,-Ci2), Bbar = (Br2,Bi2)
324	        dBr2 = sg["dBbar"][..., 0]; dBi2 = sg["dBbar"][..., 1]
325	        dCr2 = sg["dCbar"][..., 0]; dCi2 = -sg["dCbar"][..., 1]
326	        grads[pre + "mixer.B_bias"] = dBr2.sum(dim=(0, 1))
327	        grads[pre + "mixer.Bhat_bias"] = dBi2.sum(dim=(0, 1))
328	        grads[pre + "mixer.C_bias"] = dCr2.sum(dim=(0, 1))
329	        grads[pre + "mixer.Chat_bias"] = dCi2.sum(dim=(0, 1))
330	        dBr, grads[pre + "mixer.B_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dBr2, lc["Bcache"])
331	        dBi, grads[pre + "mixer.Bhat_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dBi2, lc["Bicache"])
332	        dCr, grads[pre + "mixer.C_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dCr2, lc["Ccache"])
333	        dCi, grads[pre + "mixer.Chat_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dCi2, lc["Cicache"])
334	        # dt: ddt(post-softplus) -> dt_pre via softplus' -> dt_proj bwd (dY bf16)
335	        ddt_pre = sg["ddt"] * softplus_grad(lc["dt_pre"])
336	        ddt_pre_b = bf(ddt_pre)                                 # dt_proj dY bf16
337	        grads[pre + "mixer.dt_proj.weight"] = ddt_pre_b.reshape(-1, H).t() @ lc["dt_lr_b"].reshape(-1, lc["dt_rank"])
338	        grads[pre + "mixer.dt_proj.bias"] = ddt_pre_b.reshape(-1, H).sum(0)
339	        ddt_lr = ddt_pre_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.dt_proj.weight"])  # fp32 [.,dt_rank]
340	        # A_real = -softplus(A_arg); A_arg = A_mod + exp(A_log)
341	        dA_arg = sg["dA_real"] * (-softplus_grad(lc["A_arg"]))
342	        dA_mod = dA_arg
343	        grads[pre + "mixer.A_log"] = (dA_arg * lc["base_rate"].view(1, 1, -1)).sum(dim=(0, 1))
344	        # lambda = sigmoid(u_lam)
345	        du_lam = sg["dlam"] * (lc["lam"] * (1.0 - lc["lam"]))
346	        dtheta = sg["dtheta"]
347	        # reassemble x_proj output adjoint, round to bf16, x_proj bwd
348	        dproj = torch.cat([ddt_lr, dA_mod, dtheta, du_lam, dBr, dBi, dCr, dCi], dim=-1)
349	        dproj_b = bf(dproj)                                     # x_proj dY bf16
350	        grads[pre + "mixer.x_proj.weight"] = dproj_b.reshape(-1, dproj_b.shape[-1]).t() @ lc["x_in_b"].reshape(-1, di)
351	        dx_in3 = dproj_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.x_proj.weight"])    # fp32
352	        dx_in = dx_in + dx_in3
353	        # x_in = x_main (no SiLU) ; xz = [x_main | z] = in_proj(xn_mix). dY bf16.
354	        dxz = torch.cat([dx_in, dz], dim=-1)
355	        dxz_b = bf(dxz)                                         # in_proj dY bf16
356	        grads[pre + "mixer.in_proj.weight"] = dxz_b.reshape(-1, 2 * di).t() @ lc["xn_mix_b"].reshape(-1, d)
357	        dxn_mix = dxz_b @ bf(P[pre + "mixer.in_proj.weight"])   # fp32
358	        dx_mixnorm, grads[pre + "mixer_norm.weight"] = rmsnorm_backward(dxn_mix, lc["mixn_cache"])
359	        dh = dx_block + dx_mixnorm                              # x fans to block residual + mixer_norm
360	
361	    # ---- embeddings (h0 = tok[tokens] + pos[pos_ids]); dh0 bf16 ----
362	    dh_b = bf(dh)
363	    dtok = torch.zeros_like(P["tok.weight"])
364	    dtok.index_add_(0, tokens.reshape(-1), dh_b.reshape(-1, d))
365	    grads["tok.weight"] = dtok
366	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh_b.sum(dim=0)                       # [S,d]
367	    return loss.item(), grads

390	def _bf16_faithful_oracle(named, tokens, targets):
391	    """The R2.3 NAMED reference (DESIGN §5.2): the decoder fwd+bwd computed in
392	    fp64 but with EVERY value the TC kernel STORES rounded to bf16 at the SAME
393	    points (DecActs X_in/X_ctx/X_x1/X_gact, qkv, ff0pre, X_hn, every dY_*, dh0;
394	    weights bf16-on-read). Math is fp64; bf16 ONLY at the kernel's storage points.
395	
396	    Unlike autocast-bf16 (which keeps adjoints fp32 through the backward and casts
397	    only at matmul inputs), this rounds at the kernel's exact storage boundary, so
398	    a real kernel bug shows rel~1 while the intended bf16-storage shows ~bf16-floor.
399	    This is the faithful instrument that separates a bug from bf16 noise. Runs on
400	    CPU (fp64, tiny) so it never competes with the kernel for GPU memory.
401	    Transcribed from tests/hw/decoder_oracle.py with the storage rounds inserted."""
402	    import math
403	    from tests.hw.decoder_oracle import (
404	        VOCAB, D_MODEL, N_HEADS, N_LAYERS, SEQ, D_FF, D_HEAD, ATTN_SCALE,
405	        gelu, gelu_grad, layernorm_forward, layernorm_backward,
406	        softmax_lastdim, softmax_backward, _causal_mask, DecoderWeights)
407	    B16 = torch.bfloat16
408	
409	    def bf(x):
410	        return x.to(B16).to(torch.float64)
411	
412	    W = DecoderWeights.from_named({k: v.double() for k, v in named.items()})
413	    Bn, S = tokens.shape
414	    dev = tokens.device
415	    add_mask = _causal_mask(S, dev, torch.float64)
416	    pos_ids = torch.arange(S, device=dev)
417	    h = bf(bf(W.tok)[tokens] + bf(W.pos)[pos_ids].unsqueeze(0))   # X_in[0] bf16
418	    caches = []
419	    for li in range(N_LAYERS):
420	        L = W.layers[li]
421	        x_in = h
422	        qkv = bf(x_in @ bf(L["in_w"]).t() + L["in_b"].double())   # qkv bf16
423	        q, k, v = qkv.split(D_MODEL, dim=-1)
424	        def sh(t): return t.reshape(Bn, S, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
425	        qh, kh, vh = sh(q), sh(k), sh(v)
426	        scores = (qh @ kh.transpose(-2, -1)) * ATTN_SCALE + add_mask   # fp64 attn
427	        attn = softmax_lastdim(scores)
428	        ctx = (attn @ vh).permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(Bn, S, D_MODEL)
429	        ctx_b = bf(ctx)                                            # X_ctx bf16
430	        a = (ctx_b @ bf(L["out_w"]).t() + L["out_b"].double())     # fp32 work (NOT stored bf16)
431	        r1 = x_in + a
432	        x1, ln1 = layernorm_forward(r1, L["n1_w"].double(), L["n1_b"].double())
433	        x1_b = bf(x1)                                              # X_x1 bf16
434	        ff0 = x1_b @ bf(L["ff0_w"]).t() + L["ff0_b"].double()
435	        ff0_b = bf(ff0)                                            # ff0pre bf16
436	        g = bf(gelu(ff0))                                         # X_gact bf16
437	        ff2 = g @ bf(L["ff2_w"]).t() + L["ff2_b"].double()
438	        r2 = x1 + ff2
439	        h2, ln2 = layernorm_forward(r2, L["n2_w"].double(), L["n2_b"].double())
440	        h = bf(h2) if li + 1 < N_LAYERS else h2                    # X_in[li+1] bf16 / finalin fp32
441	        caches.append(dict(x_in=x_in, attn=attn, vh=vh, qh=qh, kh=kh, ctx=ctx_b,
442	                           x1=x1, x1_b=x1_b, ln1=ln1, ff0_b=ff0_b, g=g, ln2=ln2))
443	    h_last = h[:, -1, :]
444	    hn, nc = layernorm_forward(h_last, W.norm_w.double(), W.norm_b.double())
445	    hn_b = bf(hn)                                                 # X_hn bf16
446	    logits = hn_b @ W.out_w.double().t() + W.out_b.double()
447	    mx = logits.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
448	    logz = mx.squeeze(-1) + torch.log(torch.exp(logits - mx).sum(dim=-1))
449	    loss = (logz - logits.gather(1, targets.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)).mean()
450	    grads = {}
451	    sm = softmax_lastdim(logits); oh = torch.zeros_like(sm)
452	    oh.scatter_(1, targets.unsqueeze(1), 1.0)
453	    dlogits = bf((sm - oh) / Bn)                                  # dY_logits bf16
454	    grads["out.weight"] = dlogits.t() @ hn_b
455	    grads["out.bias"] = dlogits.sum(0)
456	    dhn = dlogits @ W.out_w.double()
457	    dh_last, dnw, dnb = layernorm_backward(dhn, nc)
458	    grads["norm.weight"] = dnw; grads["norm.bias"] = dnb
459	    dh = torch.zeros(Bn, S, D_MODEL, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64); dh[:, -1, :] = dh_last
460	    for li in reversed(range(N_LAYERS)):
461	        L = W.layers[li]; lc = caches[li]
462	        dr2, d2w, d2b = layernorm_backward(dh, lc["ln2"])
463	        grads[f"layers.{li}.n2.weight"] = d2w; grads[f"layers.{li}.n2.bias"] = d2b
464	        dff2 = bf(dr2)                                            # dY_ff2 bf16
465	        dx1 = dr2.clone()
466	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.2.weight"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t() @ lc["g"].reshape(-1, D_FF)
467	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.2.bias"] = dff2.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(0)
468	        dg = dff2 @ bf(L["ff2_w"])
469	        dff0 = bf(dg * gelu_grad(lc["ff0_b"]))                    # dY_ff0 bf16; gelu' reads ff0pre(bf16)
470	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.0.weight"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).t() @ lc["x1_b"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
471	        grads[f"layers.{li}.ff.0.bias"] = dff0.reshape(-1, D_FF).sum(0)
472	        dx1 = dx1 + dff0 @ bf(L["ff0_w"])
473	        dr1, d1w, d1b = layernorm_backward(dx1, lc["ln1"])
474	        grads[f"layers.{li}.n1.weight"] = d1w; grads[f"layers.{li}.n1.bias"] = d1b
475	        da = bf(dr1)                                              # dY_a bf16
476	        dx_in = dr1.clone()
477	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.out_proj.weight"] = da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).t() @ lc["ctx"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
478	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.out_proj.bias"] = da.reshape(-1, D_MODEL).sum(0)
479	        dctx = da @ bf(L["out_w"])
480	        dctxh = dctx.reshape(Bn, S, N_HEADS, D_HEAD).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)
481	        attn = lc["attn"]; vh = lc["vh"]; qh = lc["qh"]; kh = lc["kh"]
482	        dattn = dctxh @ vh.transpose(-2, -1); dvh = attn.transpose(-2, -1) @ dctxh
483	        dsc = softmax_backward(dattn, attn) * ATTN_SCALE
484	        dqh = dsc @ kh; dkh = dsc.transpose(-2, -1) @ qh
485	        def mh(t): return t.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(Bn, S, D_MODEL)
486	        dqkv = bf(torch.cat([mh(dqh), mh(dkh), mh(dvh)], dim=-1))  # dY_qkv bf16
487	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.in_proj_weight"] = dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).t() @ lc["x_in"].reshape(-1, D_MODEL)
488	        grads[f"layers.{li}.attn.in_proj_bias"] = dqkv.reshape(-1, 3 * D_MODEL).sum(0)
489	        dx_in = dx_in + dqkv @ bf(L["in_w"])
490	        dh = dx_in
491	    dh_b = bf(dh)                                                 # dh0 bf16
492	    dtok = torch.zeros_like(W.tok.double())
493	    dtok.index_add_(0, tokens.reshape(-1), dh_b.reshape(-1, D_MODEL))
494	    grads["tok.weight"] = dtok
495	    grads["pos.weight"] = dh_b.sum(0)
496	    return loss.item(), grads

"""Standalone measurement of the Mamba-3 TC grad-parity floor, unbuffered.

Replicates tests/hw/test_mamba_tc.py::test_tc_single_step_grad_parity's body but
prints each tensor's k-vs-bf16 and bf16-vs-fp64 floor incrementally so we can
calibrate the SSM-bias tol against the MEASURED floor (the decoder discipline).
"""
import os, sys, functools
print = functools.partial(print, flush=True)

_REPO = "/workspace/SuperGrok1.5/.claude/worktrees/wf_89f9a418-f9d-3"
if _REPO not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _REPO)

import torch
import tests.hw.test_mamba_tc as T

T._disable_tf32()
dev = "cuda"
print("building/loading TC module...")
mod = T._build_tc_module()
print("module ready; TOTAL =", int(mod.TOTAL))

named = T._eager_mamba3_named(seed=123)
B = 128
g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(5)
tokens = torch.randint(0, T.VOCAB, (B, T.SEQ), generator=g)
targets = torch.randint(0, T.P_HEAD, (B,), generator=g)

print("running bf16-faithful oracle (CPU fp64)...")
loss_o, grads_o = T._bf16_faithful_mamba_oracle(named, tokens, targets)
print(f"  bf16-faithful loss = {loss_o:.6f}")
print("running pure-fp64 oracle (the floor)...")
loss_fp, grads_fp = T._pure_fp64_oracle(named, tokens, targets)
print(f"  pure-fp64 loss = {loss_fp:.6f}")

params = T._flat(named).to(dev)
total = int(mod.TOTAL)
state = torch.zeros(3 * total, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
print("running TC kernel step...")
loss_k, kgrad = T._run_tc_step(mod, params.clone(), tokens.to(dev), targets.to(dev),
                               state, lr=1e-3, betas=(0.9, 0.98), wd=0.0, eps=1e-8, step=1)
loss_k = float(loss_k.item()); kgrad = kgrad.cpu().double()
rel_loss = abs(loss_k - loss_o) / (abs(loss_o) + 1e-30)
print(f"[mbtc] loss kernel={loss_k:.6f} bf16-oracle={loss_o:.6f} rel={rel_loss:.2e}  (tol {T._TC_LOSS_REL})")

lay = T.mamba3_param_layout()
print("\n%-30s %12s %12s %8s" % ("tensor", "k-vs-bf16", "bf16-vs-fp64", "ratio"))
rows = []
for name, off, sz, shape in zip(lay["names"], lay["offsets"], lay["sizes"], lay["shapes"]):
    kg = kgrad[off:off + sz].reshape(shape)
    og = grads_o[name]; fp = grads_fp[name].double()
    a = (kg - og).abs().max().item(); denom = og.abs().max().item() + 1e-30
    rel = a / denom
    bff = (og - fp).abs().max().item() / denom
    ratio = rel / (bff + 1e-30)
    rows.append((name, rel, bff, ratio))
    print("%-30s %12.4e %12.4e %8.2f" % (name, rel, bff, ratio))

print("\n=== SSM bias group (the high-cancellation tensors) ===")
BIAS = ("B_bias", "Bhat_bias", "C_bias", "Chat_bias")
for name, rel, bff, ratio in rows:
    if any(name.endswith(b) for b in BIAS):
        print("%-30s k-vs-bf16=%.4e  floor=%.4e  ratio=%.2f" % (name, rel, bff, ratio))

# worst over the CURRENT contract tol 0.08 (everything)
worst08 = max((r[1] for r in rows))
print(f"\nmax k-vs-bf16 over ALL tensors = {worst08:.4e}")
print(f"max bf16-vs-fp64 floor over ALL = {max(r[2] for r in rows):.4e}")
